_note: 3 questions per stop. stopId must match an id in locations.json. ALL are verified:false: the team must check each one on-site before launch. Options are shuffled in the game, so the answer index here can be anything.

questions.text: Which Lockwood floor is meant for quiet study?
questions.explain: The 4th floor study area is set up for focused, distraction-free work.

questions.text: What is Lockwood's 1st floor set up for?
questions.explain: The 1st floor has large tables for group and individual study.

questions.text: What is Lockwood room 520?
questions.explain: Room 520 is a bookable group room with screens and whiteboards.

questions.text: Which library is inside Capen Hall?
questions.explain: The Oscar A. Silverman Library is in Capen Hall.

questions.text: What is 1Capen?
options: A one-stop hub for student services
questions.explain: 1Capen groups key offices like financial aid and the registrar in one place.

questions.text: You lost your UB card. Where do you go?
questions.explain: The UB Card Office is at 1 Capen Hall.

questions.text: Which departments are based in Davis Hall?
questions.explain: Davis Hall is home to Computer Science and Engineering and Electrical Engineering.

questions.text: Davis Hall belongs to which school?
options: School of Engineering and Applied Sciences
questions.explain: Davis Hall was built as a home for UB Engineering.

questions.text: What is the big open space along the front of Davis Hall?
questions.explain: Davis is built around a glass-enclosed, multi-story gallery with open staircases.

questions.text: Which food spot does the Student Union have?
questions.explain: The Student Union sign lists Pistachio's.

questions.text: Which student government office is in the Student Union?
questions.explain: The sign lists Student Associations.

questions.text: What kind of entrance does the Student Union sign mark?
questions.explain: The sign marks a barrier-free (accessible) entry.

questions.text: Which department is based in the Center for the Arts?
questions.explain: The Center for the Arts houses Theatre and Dance, Media Study and Visual Studies.

questions.text: Which gallery is inside the Center for the Arts?
questions.explain: The UB Art Gallery is inside the Center for the Arts.

questions.text: About how many seats does the Mainstage theater have?
questions.explain: The Mainstage theater seats about 1,750 people.

questions.text: What was Broadview Arena called before?
questions.explain: Broadview Arena was formerly named Alumni Arena.

questions.text: What is in the building attached to the arena's north side?
questions.explain: The Phase II building has an Olympic-size pool and a diving well.

questions.text: Which UB teams play in the arena's main gym?
questions.explain: The main gym is home to Bulls men's and women's basketball.

questions.text: Which department's main office is in the Natural Sciences Complex?
questions.explain: The Department of Chemistry's office is in 359 Natural Sciences Complex.

questions.text: What does NSC stand for?
questions.explain: NSC is the Natural Sciences Complex.

questions.text: You need the Biological Sciences office. Is it in NSC?
questions.explain: Biological Sciences is in Cooke Hall, not NSC. Easy to mix up.

questions.text: Which department is based in Clemens Hall?
questions.explain: The Department of English is in 306 Clemens Hall.

questions.text: Which language department has its main office in Clemens?
questions.explain: Romance Languages and Literatures is in 910 Clemens Hall.

questions.text: Which college's main office is in Clemens Hall?
questions.explain: The College of Arts and Sciences office is at 810 Clemens Hall.
